# Anand Aggarwal Properties

> Anand Aggarwal Properties is a Delhi-based real estate consultancy, established in 1985, that specialises in pre-leased commercial properties (banks, retail brands, food chains, hospitals and offices already let to tenants) in Delhi and Gurugram. It also deals in residential plots, kothis, floors and apartments in North and West Delhi and DLF/Gurugram, as well as industrial properties, Kundli/Sonepat properties and farmhouses across Delhi NCR. The firm supports buyers, sellers and investors with property selection, documentation, legal assistance and loans. Property prices and rents are shared on enquiry.

Key facts:
- Business: Anand Aggarwal Properties (real estate consultant and broker)
- Established: 1985 (the site cites 40+ years of experience)
- Office: B-27, Pushpanjali Enclave, Outer Ring Road, Pitampura, Delhi
- Phone: +91 9810395051 and +91 9899151090 (office); +91 9810327243 (WhatsApp and click-to-call)
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919810327243
- Email: anandaggarwalproperties1@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/anandaggarwalproperties
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100064072301431
- Markets served: Delhi (North, West, Central and South) and Gurugram; also Kundli/Sonepat, Noida, Greater Noida and other NCR areas
- Property types: pre-leased commercial, residential (plots, kothis, builder floors, apartments), industrial (plots, factories, warehouses), farmhouses and agricultural land
- Pre-leased returns: the site quotes 5% to 10% annual rental returns. Returns vary by property, so confirm figures and lease documents with the firm before deciding.
- Tenant types on listings: banks (HDFC, ICICI, Bandhan, Union), retail and food brands, gyms, cinemas, hospitals, banquet halls and multi-tenant buildings
- Services offered: buying, selling and leasing advisory, lease and document verification, loan and handover support

## Residential coverage (see Services page)

- North and West Delhi plots, kothis and floors: Pushpanjali Enclave, Deepali/Tarun Enclave, Lotus/West Enclave, Saraswati Vihar, Suvidha Kunj, Lok Vihar/Harsh Vihar, Vaishali Enclave, Sharda Niketan, Rajdhani/M.P. Enclave, Rohini, Pitampura, Punjabi Bagh
- DLF/Gurgaon plots, kothis and floors: DLF Phases I to IV, Sushant Lok I to III, South City I and II, Suncity, Dwarka Expressway, Golf Course Extension
- DLF/Gurgaon apartments: DLF Aralias, Camelias and Privana, M3M, Signature Global, Birla, Adani, Krisumi, Suncity
- North West Delhi apartments: Unity Amaryllis, DLF Mid Town (Moti Nagar), Maxwell (Rohini Sector 32), Golf Island Dwarka
